codex.device_management_policy_does_not_.en: Device management policy does not allow the selected file access scope.

codex.device_management_policy_does_not_.zh-CN: 此设备的管理策略不允许所选审批方式。
codex.device_management_policy_does_not_.en: Device management policy does not allow the selected approval policy.

codex.device_management_policy_does_not_.zh-CN: 此设备的管理策略未启用自动审查。
codex.device_management_policy_does_not_.en: Device management policy does not enable automatic review.

codex.codex_is_still_running_earlier_mes.zh-CN: Codex 仍在运行，暂不能编辑之前的消息。
codex.codex_is_still_running_earlier_mes.en: Codex is still running. Earlier messages cannot be edited yet.

questions.a_question_request_must_contai.zh-CN: 提问需要包含 1 至 12 个问题。
questions.a_question_request_must_contai.en: A question request must contain 1–12 questions.

questions.duplicate_question_id_or_inval.zh-CN: 问题标识重复或正文无效。
questions.duplicate_question_id_or_inval.en: Duplicate question ID or invalid question text.

questions.the_question_content_is_too_lo.zh-CN: 提问内容过长，请拆分后重新询问。
questions.the_question_content_is_too_lo.en: The question content is too long. Split it into smaller requests.

questions.answers_are_being_submitted_do.zh-CN: 答案正在提交，请勿重复提交。
questions.answers_are_being_submitted_do.en: Answers are being submitted. Do not submit them again.

questions.different_answers_were_already.zh-CN: 此问题已提交其他答案。
questions.different_answers_were_already.en: Different answers were already submitted for this question.

questions.the_question_ended_or_the_conn.zh-CN: 问题已结束或连接已失效，请让 Agent 重新提问。
questions.the_question_ended_or_the_conn.en: The question ended or the connection expired. Ask the agent to send it again.

questions.invalid_answer_format_check_yo.zh-CN: 答案格式无效，请检查选择或输入的文字。

questions.total_answer_length_cannot_exc.zh-CN: 答案总长度不能超过 65,536 字符。
questions.total_answer_length_cannot_exc.en: Total answer length cannot exceed 65,536 characters.

questions.the_question_was_cancelled_dur.zh-CN: 提交时问题已取消，请查看任务状态。
questions.the_question_was_cancelled_dur.en: The question was cancelled during submission. Check the task status.

service.history_changed_while_preparing_.zh-CN: 准备交接时历史发生变化，请重试；原 harness 保持不变。
service.history_changed_while_preparing_.en: History changed while preparing the handoff. Retry; the original harness is unchanged.

service.this_input_exceeds_the_conservat.zh-CN: 本次输入超过保守交接预算，请缩短新消息；历史未截断，尚未提交模型。
service.this_input_exceeds_the_conservat.en: This input exceeds the conservative handoff budget. Shorten the new message. History was not truncated and nothing was sent to the model.

service.the_handoff_is_incomplete_earlie.zh-CN: 交接尚未完成，暂不能编辑之前的消息。
service.the_handoff_is_incomplete_earlie.en: The handoff is incomplete. Earlier messages cannot be edited yet.

context.unconfirmed_writes_occurred_afte.zh-CN: 交接提交后有未确认写入；未自动覆盖。
context.unconfirmed_writes_occurred_afte.en: Unconfirmed writes occurred after handoff submission. They were not overwritten automatically.

handoff.conversation_history_is_incomple.zh-CN: 会话历史不完整或格式不受支持，无法可靠交接；原 harness 保持不变。
handoff.conversation_history_is_incomple.en: Conversation history is incomplete or uses an unsupported format, so handoff cannot be performed reliably. The original harness is unchanged.

handoff.unsupported_handoff_record_forma.zh-CN: 交接记录格式不受支持，未覆盖现有会话。
handoff.unsupported_handoff_record_forma.en: Unsupported handoff record format. The existing conversation was not overwritten.

handoff.unsupported_handoff_confirmation.zh-CN: 交接确认格式不受支持，未覆盖现有会话。
handoff.unsupported_handoff_confirmation.en: Unsupported handoff confirmation format. The existing conversation was not overwritten.

timing.timing_records_cannot_be_linked_f.zh-CN: 计时记录不能使用链接文件。
timing.timing_records_cannot_be_linked_f.en: Timing records cannot be linked files.

timing.this_timing_record_was_not_found.en: This timing record was not found.

profiles.this_development_task_s_model_c.zh-CN: 无法跟随此开发会话的模型，请在设置 → DreamAgent 中选择独立模型。

projection.compatibility_caption.zh-CN: 请调查并修复提交到 {p0} 的兼容性问题。
